title: CareerLens In-App Notification and Task Search Contract v1
rules: Notification content is derived at read time from durable facts: pending approvals, failed/interrupted agent runs, failed tasks, and skipped/failed schedule occurrences.
Only the read receipt is persisted; notifications never create a second source of truth and are never delivered outside the app.
A fact_key is stable and unique per user and fact; marking read is idempotent.
No email, webhook, push, SMS or any external destination is used; the centre is read-only except for read receipts.
Task search is read-only, scoped to the authenticated user's sessions, tasks, roles and schedules, with a bounded result limit.
Search never returns another user's content and never reveals existence across tenants.
Sleep/wake and notification delivery timing remain unverified; this contract covers in-app state only.
